MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

2. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

4. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 13
   D. 9

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 13

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

13. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

15. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 0

16. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
